description: A basket that pushes the week past the flex band flags WeeklyOver and asks to approve or trim (soft cap, never refuses).

input.userMessage: Reconcile a 170.00 basket against a 140 weekly target (154 upper flex threshold) with nothing spent yet.

expectedBehavior.outputFormat: JSON BudgetVerdict with outcome WeeklyOver and RequiresApproval true.
expectedBehavior.decisionCriteria: Projected weekly total above target + flex but under the cycle cap must produce WeeklyOver.

scoring.passCriteria: Verdict is WeeklyOver and the summary asks to approve or trim.
